description: This PHP source file handles wireless network configuration updates, including enabling/disabling SSID, security settings, encryption modes, passwords, and other wireless-related parameters. It processes form input data ($_POST) to update device WiFi settings via specific setStr and DmExtSetStrsWithRootObj function calls.

methods.name: MiniApplySSID
methods.description: Applies a setting to a specific SSID to restart or enable it based on the SSID index.
